QuestInfo.name: Training Center for Beginning Pirates
QuestInfo.0: After making a job advancement as a Pirate, you need to find a training center that'll help you level up faster.
QuestInfo.1: After making a job advancement as a Pirate, you should follow the arrows from the Nautilus that lead you to a training center. You won't be able to enter once you reach Level 20.
QuestInfo.2: You found the training center for beginning Pirates. You'll be able to receive your first set of training lessons from the trainer, Power B. Fore.

0.0: Congratulations on making the job advancement as a pirate. I can see you're exuding the quiet confidence of a powerful pirate, and yet...you seem to lack something. I suggest you train a bit more at the Training Center, where you can become even more formidable. I'll teach you how to get to the Training Center. Are you interested?

yes.0: That's great! Go outside, and you'll see a series of arrows pointing in a certain direction. Follow them and you'll see the entrance to the Training Center, where you can train to become even more powerful!
yes.1: I suggest you go there before you reach Level 20, because you won't be allowed inside afterwards.

no.0: Ah, really? Well, the Training Center can be found nearby, so maybe you can find it on your own. Best of luck to you!

1.0: Welcome, welcome. #bKyrin#k has already contacted me about this. So you're a beginner pirate? Train with me for a bit, and you'll be able to improve in a jiffy.

yes.0: Before we start, let me show you this letter of commendation I received for being an exemplary adventurer. I don't like to brag, but I used to be quite the adventurer, you know! Hold on one second, while I find that letter...

npc.0: Here, you can rapidly move up the ranks and become an intermediate-level pirate.
